motions.info_slide_plain:
Free schools are also called democratic-free schools or democratic education.
They tend to have a commitment to “education in which young people have the
freedom to organize their daily activities, and in which there is equality and
democratic decision-making among young people and adults.”  
In a school setting, free-school students would self-direct their days and
their own curriculum. They would choose what, how, when, and with whom to
study. Adults in a free-school space act more as mentors and guides than
traditional teachers, allowing students time to process things in their own
way.

motions.info_slide_plain:
Advanced Analytics is the autonomous or semi-autonomous examination of data or
content. It involves using sophisticated techniques such as machine learning
algorithms, deep learning, predictive modelling, or other tools to discover
deeper insights, make predictions, or generate recommendations.  
Advanced Analytics can be used for political microtargeting, which involves
identifying the detailed profile of individual voters and voter groups,
testing the most persuasive messages, and tailoring campaign strategy to
target different voter profiles.
